name: reverseAcc_fusion
prelude:
def reverseAcc : List α → List α → List α
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => reverseAcc xs (x :: acc)
statement: theorem reverseAcc_fusion (xs ys acc : List α) : reverseAcc (xs ++ ys) acc = reverseAcc ys (reverseAcc xs acc)
proofs:
induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simpa [reverseAcc] using ih (x :: acc)
  have model (as bs : List α) : reverseAcc as bs = as.reverse ++ bs := by
    induction as generalizing bs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a as ih => simp [reverseAcc, ih, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]
  simp [model, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc]
strategies: Induct on xs with the accumulator generalized.
Prove the reverse-plus-suffix model, then calculate using reverse_append.
